mapper.select: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN test_record tr ON tr.id = tad.test_record_id WHERE tr.user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_question_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId})) AS answeredTotal, ((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(tad.is_correct), 0) FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN test_record tr ON tr.id = tad.test_record_id WHERE tr.user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(is_correct), 0) FROM user_question_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId})) AS correctTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS mockCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_note WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS noteCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS wrongTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (master_status IS NULL OR master_status <> 'MASTERED')) AS wrongOpen, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND master_status = 'MASTERED') AS wrongMastered

SELECT subjectCode, SUM(answered) AS answered, SUM(correct) AS correct FROM ( SELECT UPPER(eq.subject_code) AS subjectCode, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(tad.is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN test_record tr ON tr.id = tad.test_record_id LEFT JOIN exam_question eq ON eq.id = tad.question_id WHERE tr.user_id = #{userId} AND eq.subject_code IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(subject_code) AS subjectCode, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM user_question_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND subject_code IS NOT NULL ) attempts GROUP BY subjectCode
SELECT UPPER(subject_code) AS subjectCode, COUNT(*) AS mastered FROM user_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND master_status = 'MASTERED' GROUP BY UPPER(subject_code)
SELECT UPPER(subject_code) AS subjectCode, COUNT(*) AS total FROM exam_question GROUP BY UPPER(subject_code)
SELECT UPPER(subject_code) AS subjectCode, IFNULL(AVG(accuracy_rate), 0) AS avgAccuracy, COUNT(*) AS pointCount FROM user_knowledge_mastery WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY UPPER(subject_code)

SELECT day, SUM(answered) AS answered, SUM(correct) AS correct FROM ( SELECT DATE(tr.created_at) AS day, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(tad.is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN test_record tr ON tr.id = tad.test_record_id WHERE tr.user_id = #{userId} AND tr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM user_question_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
SELECT test_title AS testTitle, user_score AS userScore, total_score AS totalScore, created_at AS createdAt FROM test_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) FROM user_question_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_type = 'DAILY_PUSH'
